items.name: Bánh bột lọc tran 100ct
items.description: Delicate tapioca dumplings, filled with a savory mixture of shrimp and pork, and steamed to perfection. These translucent dumplings are served with traditional fish sauce for dipping, offering a delightful balance of chewy texture and bold flavors. It's a classic Vietnamese dish that's simple yet flavorful.

items.name: Bò kho 32oz
items.description: Bò kho is a fragrant and hearty Vietnamese beef stew, featuring tender chunks of beef slowly braised with carrots and onions in a richly spiced broth. Infused with bold flavors from lemongrass, star anise, cinnamon, and other aromatic spices, it delivers a perfect balance of savory, sweet, and slightly tangy notes.  Garnished with fresh mint leaves.

items.name: Cà ri gà 32oz
items.description: A comforting Vietnamese chicken curry featuring tender pieces of chicken, hearty potatoes, and carrots, all simmered in a rich, aromatic coconut milk-based broth. Infused with fragrant spices like lemongrass and curry powder, this dish is savory, slightly sweet, and deeply flavorful.

items.name: Cánh gà chiên bơ
items.description: Golden, crispy chicken wings fried to perfection and coated in a rich, fragrant butter glaze. The buttery flavor adds a luscious depth to the crispy exterior, making these wings irresistibly savory and indulgent. A simple yet flavorful dish that's sure to please.

items.name: Cánh gà chiên nước mắm
items.description: Crispy fried chicken wings, perfectly golden and tossed in a flavorful fish sauce glaze. The balance of savory, slightly sweet, and umami flavors creates an irresistible coating that complements the juicy tenderness of the wings. A crowd-pleasing dish that's simple yet bold in taste, garnished with sliced onions and jalapenos.

items.name: Cơm chiên dương châu PT
items.description: Yangzhou fried rice is a colorful and flavorful Chinese-inspired dish, featuring fragrant fried rice mixed with diced vegetables, scrambled eggs, and savory proteins including shrimp, pork, chicken and Chinese sausage. Each ingredient is finely chopped to ensure a harmonious blend of textures and tastes, with a light seasoning that enhances the dish's balance and aroma.

items.name: Gỏi cuốn PT/Spring rolls
items.description: Gỏi cuốn—also known as Vietnamese spring rolls—are a refreshing and light dish made with tender pork, juicy shrimp, vermicelli noodles, crisp lettuce, and fragrant herbs, all delicately wrapped in soft rice paper. Served with a traditional peanut dipping sauce, these rolls offer a perfect balance of fresh and savory flavors.

items.name: Gỏi đu đủ bò khô
items.description: A refreshing green papaya salad, featuring crisp, julienned papaya as the base, complemented by strips of savory, chewy beef jerky. The dish is elevated with fresh mint leaves and paired with a traditional Vietnamese dipping sauce that balances sweet, tangy, and savory flavors. It’s a vibrant and flavorful appetizer that’s both satisfying and packed with texture.

items.name: Gỏi sứa ngó sen tôm thịt
items.description: A refreshing Vietnamese salad featuring crunchy lotus root and tender jellyfish, paired with succulent shrimp and slices of pork. The dish is elevated with fresh herbs and tossed in a savory and tangy fish sauce dressing. It’s a delightful medley of textures and flavors, showcasing the balance of sweetness, saltiness, and aromatic freshness.

items.name: Mì xào PT
items.description: Stir-fried egg noodles tossed with a flavorful mix of tender chicken, juicy shrimp, and an array of fresh, crisp vegetables. The dish is seasoned with aromatic spices and sauces, creating a perfect balance of savory and slightly sweet flavors. It's a comforting and versatile meal that's both hearty and satisfying

items.name: Tôm rang muối
items.description: Golden, crispy prawns are stir-fried with a perfect balance of salt and pepper, creating a lightly spiced coating that enhances their natural sweetness. Aromatics like garlic and scallions are often added, lending depth and fragrance to the dish. This simple yet flavorful preparation results in prawns that are savory, slightly zesty, and irresistibly satisfying.

items.name: Xôi gà lạp xưởng PT
items.description: A comforting dish of sticky rice topped with tender, flavorful chicken and slices of savory Chinese sausage. The dish is garnished with crispy fried shallots and fresh green onions, adding both texture and fragrance. It's a satisfying and hearty meal, perfect for any time of the day.

items.name: Miển xào tôm cua
items.description: Delicate cellophane noodles are stir-fried until perfectly tender, absorbing the flavors of succulent shrimp and sweet crab meat. The dish is often enhanced with aromatics like garlic and shallots, creating a savory base, while a touch of fish sauce balances the flavors beautifully.

items.name: Gỏi đu đủ tôm thịt
items.description: A vibrant and refreshing green papaya salad featuring crisp, julienned papaya as the base. This salad is paired with tender slices of pork and juicy shrimp, adding a delightful balance of flavors and textures. Fresh herbs like cilantro and mint elevate the dish with aromatic notes, while the special fish sauce dressing ties everything together with a perfect blend of savory, tangy, and slightly sweet flavors.

items.name: Spaghetti Party Tray
items.description: Spaghetti bolognese with an Asian twist.  One of our best sellers now available in party tray size.  Contains ground beef and slices of pork sausage links.

items.name: Nui Xào Bò PT
items.description: Stir-fried pasta mixed with tender beef filet and sautéed onions, coated in a light tomato paste sauce. A satisfying and savory combination that's hearty yet refreshing.

items.name: Chả tôm bọc trứng cút

category_description: Noodles

items.name: Bánh canh
items.description: Vietnamese thick tapioca noodle soup in a savory broth, accompanied by shrimp, pork, pork trotter and blood cubes. It's garnished with green onions, fried garlic, cilantro, and a dash of black pepper for extra flavor. It's hearty, comforting, and brimming with rich flavors!

items.name: Bò kho
items.description: Bò kho is a fragrant and hearty Vietnamese beef stew, featuring tender chunks of beef slowly braised with carrots and onions in a richly spiced broth. Infused with bold flavors from lemongrass, star anise, cinnamon, and other aromatic spices, it delivers a perfect balance of savory, sweet, and slightly tangy notes.  Garnished with fresh mint leaves, onions, and served with your choice of french baguette, rice noodles or egg noodles.  Please specify when ordering.

items.name: Bún bò huế
items.description: Spicy Vietnamese beef and pork noodle soup. It features thick rice noodles in a flavorful and aromatic broth made from a mix of lemongrass, shrimp paste, and chili oil. The dish is garnished with fresh herbs, green onions, and lime wedges for an extra zing. It's a perfect combination of spicy, savory, and slightly tangy flavors!

items.name: Bún mọc
items.description: Vietnamese pork paste and pork riblet rice noodle soup. This comforting dish features a light, savory broth flavored with green onions, cilantro, fried garlic, and black pepper. It's a harmonious combination of tender pork riblets, flavorful pork paste (meatballs), and silky rice noodles, creating a heartwarming and delicious meal.

items.name: Bún riêu
items.description: Vietnamese crab and tomato noodle soup. This flavorful dish features silky rice noodles in a tangy, slightly sweet broth made with tomatoes and pork/crab paste. It is garnished with fresh herbs, fried tofu, green onions, and blood cubes. The dish offers a delightful balance of savory, sour, and umami flavors.

items.name: Súp nui

items.name: Nui Xào Bò

category_description: Rice Porridge

items.name: Cháo lòng
items.description: Vietnamese rice porridge with pork intestines and offal. This hearty dish features creamy rice porridge combined with a variety of pork organ meats and blood cubes, seasoned with green onions, ginger, cilantro, fried garlic, and black pepper. It's a beloved dish in Vietnam, offering rich flavors and textures.

items.name: Cháo dồi huyết
items.description: Vietnamese rice porridge with pork sausage and blood cubes. This comforting dish combines creamy rice porridge with slices of rich and flavorful pork sausage and blood cubes, accompanied by green onions, ginger, cilantro, fried garlic and black pepper for added aroma and taste.

items.name: Cháo thịt bằm
items.description: Vietnamese minced pork rice porridge. This comforting dish is made by slow-cooking rice into a creamy, soup-like consistency and incorporating minced pork for added flavor and heartiness. It's garnished with green onions, ginger, cilantro, fried garlic, and black pepper, making it both nutritious and delicious. It's a popular choice for breakfast or as a light meal.

items.name: Cháo bắc thảo
items.description: Vietnamese rice porridge with century egg and minced pork. This dish features creamy rice porridge paired with slices of century egg and minced pork, which is known for its unique flavor and creamy texture. It's garnished with green onions, ginger, cilantro, fried garlic, and black pepper, creating a comforting and flavorful meal.

items.name: Cháo cá
items.description: Vietnamese fish rice porridge. This comforting dish features creamy rice porridge paired with tender and flavorful fish fillets. It's garnished with fresh herbs like green onions and cilantro, along with fried garlic and black pepper for added aroma and taste. Ginger is included to enhance the flavor and provide a warming touch. It's a nutritious and satisfying meal, perfect for any time of the day!

items.name: Cháo gà
items.description: Vietnamese chicken rice porridge that is made by slow-cooking rice until it reaches a creamy consistency, then adding tender pieces of chicken for a flavorful and nutritious meal. It's garnished with green onions, ginger, cilantro, fried garlic, and a dash of black pepper, and served with lime wedge, bean sprouts and chili on the side.

items.name: Egg Roll
items.description: Chả giò, also known as Vietnamese eggrolls, is a delightful dish with a golden, crispy exterior. The filling is a harmonious blend of minced pork, shrimp, glass noodles, wood ear mushrooms, jicama, shredded carrots, and seasonings, offering a balance of natural sweetness and savory flavors. Wrapped in thin rice paper, the rolls are carefully folded and deep-fried until perfectly golden and crispy. Chả giò is typically served with fresh herbs like lettuce and mint, accompanied by a tangy and sweet fish sauce dip, creating a perfect balance of flavors and textures. This dish is a beloved staple in Vietnamese cuisine.
